Frosty the snowman
[Eb]Happy happy snowman

[Verse 1]
[Bb]Frosty the
snowman was a
[Eb]jolly happy
[Bb]soul With a
[Eb]corncob pipe and a
[Bb]button nose and two
[F]eyes made out of
[Bb]coal
Frosty the
snowman is a
[Eb]fairy tale they
[Bb]say He was
[Eb]made of snow but the
[Bb]children know how he
[F]came to life one
[Bb]day There
[Eb]must have been some
[Bb]magic in that
[F]old silk that they
[Bb]found For
[F]when they placed it
on his head he be-
[C]gan to dance a-
[F]round
[Bb]Frosty the
snowman was a-
[Eb]live as he could
[Bb]be And the
[Eb]children say he could
[Bb]laugh and play just the
[F]same as you and
[Bb]me

[Bridge]
[Bb]
[Eb]
[C]
[F]

[Verse 2]
[Bb]Frosty the
snowman knew the
[Eb]sun was hot that
[Bb]day So he
[Eb]said let's run and we'll
[Bb]have some fun now be-
[F]fore I melt a-
[Bb]way
Down to the
village with a
[Eb]broomstick in his
[Bb]hand Running
[Eb]here and there all a-
[Bb]round the square saying
[F]catch me if you
[Bb]can He
[Eb]led them down the
[Bb]streets of town right
[F]to the traffic
[Bb]cop And he
[F]only paused a
moment when he
[C]heard him holler
[F]stop
[Bb]Frosty the
snowman had to
[Eb]hurry on his
[Bb]way But he
[Eb]waved goodbye sayin'
[Bb]don't you cry I'll be
[F]back again some
[Bb]day

[Bb]
